row:
Established in the heart of the City of London in 2006, we have built up a reputation for excellence in providing clinically proven treatment for low back pain, neck pain and sports injuries.

Our experienced team of chiropractors and sports massage therapists work to ensure the highest level of non-surgical care.

A comprehensive assessment combined with excellent diagnostic skills allows our dedicated practitioners to provide an individually tailored treatment plan, ranging from hands-on treatment and providing pain relief to exercise plans and advice to reduce recurrence.

We have provided relief for a range of patients from sedentary, city-based office workers to international performance artists, dancers and professional sportspeople.
